## Word counts

Here are the page counts for each chapter.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: setup

library(glue)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| label: page-counts

count_words <- function(fn) {
  fn |>
    paste0(collapse=" ") |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z A-Z]", " ") |>
    str_replace_all(" +", "~") |> 
    str_split("~") |>
    unlist() |>
    length()
}

read_lines(file="../index.qmd") |>
  count_words() -> n

file_list <- list.files(path="../chapters")
for (fn in file_list) {
  read_lines(glue("../chapters/{fn}")) |>
    count_words() -> ni
  n <- append(n, ni)
}
n_total <- sum(n)
paste0("-   ", file_list, ": ", n) |>
  paste0(collapse="\n") -> chapter_count
write_lines(
  c(n_total, n), 
  file=paste0(Sys.Date(), ".txt"))
```

There are approximately `r format(n_total, big.mark=",")` words in the book. I use the word "approximate" because it is easy to count something that isn't a word. The word counts for individual chapters are

`r chapter_count`

## Changes in word count

```{r}
#| label: show changes

progress_files <- list.files(pattern="*.txt")

historical_counts <- tibble(
  section=c(
    "Entire book",
    "Preface", 
    file_list))

for (progress_file in progress_files) {
  historical_count <- read_table(
    file=progress_file,
    col_names=progress_file,
    col_types="n")
  historical_counts |>
    bind_cols(historical_count) -> historical_counts
}
```

```{r}
#| label: changes

n_dates <- length(progress_files)

for (i in n_dates:n_dates) {
  delta_counts <- historical_counts[i+1] - historical_counts[i]
  historical_counts[ , c(1, i)] |>
    bind_cols(tibble(delta_counts)) -> improvement
  print(improvement, n=25)
}
```

## Sections within chapters

```{r}
#| label: sections

for (file_name in file_list) {
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(file_name)
  
  file_text <- read_lines(file=glue("../chapters/{file_name}")) 
  
  file_text |>
    str_subset(pattern="##") |>
    str_replace("## ", "\n- ") -> sections
  
  sections <- c("\n- Introduction", sections)
  
  file_text |>
    str_which("##") -> borders
  
  start <- c(1, borders-1)
  stop <- c(borders, length(file_text))
  
  section_counts <- NULL
  for (i in 1:length(start)) {
    file_text[start[i]:stop[i]] |>
      count_words() |>
      append(section_counts) -> section_counts
  }
  cat(paste0(sections, ", ", section_counts))
}
```
